from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial snapshot for a single company required to calculate the Z-Score."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code or ticker of the company")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025-03-31'")
    
    # Numerators for X1, X2, X3 components
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="货币资金 (Monetary Funds)")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="应收账款 (Accounts Receivable)")
    inventory: float | None = Field(description="存货 (Inventory)")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="应付账款 (Accounts Payable)")
    contract_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="合同负债 (Contract Liabilities)")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="未分配利润 (Undistributed Profit)")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="营业收入 (Operating Revenue)")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="总资产 (Total Assets)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancialData]
